recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-29784 unless a future build artifact stops reflecting the active StructureDefinition source.
issue_request: FHIR-29784 was a Published FHIR-core/List change request resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested adding Organization and Practitioner to List.subject for non-clinical use cases, clarifying List.date as the date the list was last reviewed/revised and determined current, and considering explanatory text for List.source when PractitionerRole is used.
initial_application: Commit 61bf144e3ab23f4d6701cc798a975dc747829ed9 appears to be the original application: it added Organization and Practitioner target profiles to List.subject and changed the List.date definition to the approved current-date wording. It did not add special List.source prose, matching the Jira resolution.
additional_context: The Jira comment and linked Zulip thread record the assumption that PractitionerRole should be included for List.subject. FHIR-I minutes from 2021-02-15 confirm the FHIR-29784 vote, List.date as the last updated date, and PractitionerRole vs Practitioner as handled elsewhere. Later Published issues FHIR-39104 and FHIR-39105 broadened the same List.subject element to Reference(Any) and 0..*, and both are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. In the active List resource source, List.subject is Reference(Resource), which covers Organization, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, and other resources; List.date retains the approved definition; and List.source includes PractitionerRole without redundant explanatory prose.

related_jiras.note: Later relaxed the same List.subject target type restriction to Reference(Any), superseding the narrower FHIR-29784 fixed target-profile addition; an audit commit for FHIR-39104 is already on the combined branch.
Later changed the same List.subject element to 0..* and added multiple-subject guidance; an audit commit for FHIR-39105 is already on the combined branch.
